jp.title: 台風17号の進路に注意 台風が次々発生 日本の南にモンスーンジャイア
jp.description: 日本の南の海上ではモンスーンジャイアといわれる大きな反時計回りの循環があり、台風が発生しやすい状況となっています。統計史上初めて茨城県に上陸した台風15号は熱帯低気圧に変わりましたが、小笠原近海で台風17号が発生しています。台風17号の進路の予想はバラつきが大きい状況ですが、来週以降、日本列島に影響を与えるおそれがあり、最新の情報に注意が必要です。

world.title: Buhari’s Ex-Aide, Who Once Backed Blasphemy Death Penalty, Rejects Cleric Jingir’s Claim That ‘Nigeria Is A Muslim Country’
world.description: Bashir Ahmad, former Personal Assistant to ex-President Muhammadu Buhari, has distanced himself and the global Muslim community from the controversial remarks by Islamic cleric Sheikh Yahaya Jingir that Nigeria is a Muslim country, and that Muslims outnumber Christians whom he described as “infidels”. Ahmad said the position expressed by Jingir should not be regarded as representative of all Muslims in Nigeria and across the world. Ahmad, who previously supported the death penalty for blasphemy in 2015, made the remarks in a statement posted on his X account on Tuesday.

world.title: Osun APC Senator Fadahunsi Who Said "Kill Accord Members" Makes U-Turn, Says: "I Meant Votes, Not Violence"
world.description: Senator Francis Fadahunsi, who represents Osun East Senatorial District in the National Assembly, has clarified his controversial comment in which he appeared to urge members of the All Progressives Congress (APC) to “kill” members of the Accord Party, after the remark sparked backlash and went viral on social media. Fadahunsi, a member of the APC, said his comment was not a call for violence against Accord Party members or supporters but a political metaphor urging APC supporters to defeat the party at the ballot box in the August 15 Osun State governorship election.
